create_ManagedAttribute: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor to manage typed attribute access on a Runner or Reducer class
create_ManagedAttribute_with_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor with an enforced_type to validate values on assignment
review_ManagedAttribute: review the ManagedAttribute descriptor class and its __get__, __set__, and __set_name__ methods
refactor_ManagedAttribute: refactor the ManagedAttribute descriptor to support additional validation logic beyond type enforcement
test_ManagedAttribute: test the ManagedAttribute descriptor by setting and getting values on a Runner or Reducer instance
